description: This source file defines various classes related to HTTP authentication schemes in FastAPI, including Basic, Bearer, Digest, and general HTTP authentication mechanisms. It includes models for credentials, the base security class, and specific implementations for different schemes, along with methods for handling authorization headers and authentication errors.

classes.name: HTTPBasicCredentials
classes.description: Pydantic model for storing HTTP Basic authentication credentials including username and password.

classes.name: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
classes.description: Pydantic model for storing extracted authorization scheme and credentials from headers.

classes.name: HTTPBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for implementing various HTTP authentication schemes, providing common functionality such as header handling and request authentication logic.

classes.name: HTTPBasic
classes.description: Implementation of HTTP Basic authentication, handling credential extraction and decoding from headers.

classes.name: HTTPBearer
classes.description: Implementation of Bearer token HTTP authentication, extracting token from Authorization header.

classes.name: HTTPDigest
classes.description: Stub implementation for HTTP Digest authentication, mainly for integration with OpenAPI.

methods.name: dict[str,str] make_authenticate_headers(self)
methods.description: Generates authentication headers for challenge responses (e.g., WWW-Authenticate).

methods.name: HTTPException make_not_authenticated_error(self)
methods.description: Produces an HTTP 401 Unauthorized exception with proper headers.

methods.name: Optional[HTTPBasicCredentials] __call__( self, request: Request )
methods.description: Asynchronous method to extract and verify authorization credentials from the request headers.
